sources.title: Identifying Representations for Intervention Extrapolation
sources.scope: Official conference abstract read. Direct prior art: extrapolation to unseen interventions requires identifiable representation plus explicit structural assumptions.

sources.title: Identifying Linearly-Mixed Causal Representations from Multi-Node Interventions
sources.scope: Official PMLR abstract read. Used for the role of intervention diversity/coverage in causal representation identifiability.

sources.title: Score-based Causal Representation Learning: Linear and General Transformations
sources.scope: JMLR abstract read. Used for intervention-count/type conditions behind causal representation identifiability guarantees.

sources.scope: ArXiv abstract read. Used as current finite-sample prior art; no detailed theorem imported.

novelty_status: Strong prior art for intervention-based causal representation and extrapolation. R98 is a project-specific finite synthetic stress test, not a historical-first theorem.
